messages.author: 06944580aaf62f8c
messages.subject: Incorrect date and time
parts:
Hey!

So I have about 400 images from a camera where the date and time were incorrect, but we know the date and time the first image was taken. 

Is there a way to update the first image to then subsequently change the properties for the later photos based off of this change?

Thanks!

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Incorrect date and time
parts:
Hi,

yes, use the function timeShiftImages.

If you'd rather use a graphical interface you can also do it with digiKam using the "Adjust Time Date" tool.

Best regards,

Jürgen
